subject: Performance coaching roadmap — 30-day corrective support
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Performance coaching roadmap — 30-day corrective support

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for meeting last week. Per our discussion, I’m outlining a targeted 30-day coaching roadmap so we have clear expectations and a record in case we need to escalate. Our goal here is corrective and supportive — the intention is to close the performance gaps and avoid a formal PIP.

High-level summary:
- Focus areas: task ownership (timely delivery), cross-team communication, and ticket quality (reduced rework).
- Cadence: weekly 1:1s (30 min) + biweekly checkpoints with Laura (director).
- Success metrics: 90% on-time completion for assigned Jira tickets, < 2 PR rework rate per sprint, visible updates on standups.

Actions for this week (please confirm by EOD Wed):
1) Review the attached 1:1 notes and accept the meeting invite for recurring weekly check-ins.
2) Reply with any blockers or concerns about the success metrics — if something feels unattainable, flag it now so we can adjust.
3) Add three concrete examples of recent work that you think met expectations and two that missed — we’ll walk through them in our first follow-up.

I’ll own the checkpoints and provide coaching; Vivek (People Ops) is CC’d to make sure we document things correctly. Laura — I’ll loop you into the fortnightly review so you can observe progress.

Next steps: once Marissa confirms, I’ll send calendar invites and a short milestone tracker.

Thanks,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Engineering Manager, Product Reliability
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | ext. 4321

Attachments: 1:1-notes-20270614.pdf (summary of items discussed)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Performance coaching roadmap — 30-day corrective support

Thanks, Neha — I read the notes and appreciate the clarity. I accept the recurring 1:1 invite. A couple of clarifying questions before our first check-in:

- For "90% on-time completion," is that out of all tickets assigned to me or only those I own end-to-end?
- For PR rework, is the target per sprint or per month? I want to make sure I measure consistently.

A couple of quick context points:
- Some delays were because of unclear requirements from infra; I'll note the Jira IDs in my prep so we can separate blockers from execution issues.
- I can put together the examples you asked for and will upload them to the shared Drive folder by tomorrow.

Appreciate the support — looking forward to the roadmap conversation.

—Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Software Engineer II
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Performance coaching roadmap — 30-day corrective support

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply and great questions. Short answers: 90% applies to tickets you are assigned as the primary owner (end-to-end). PR rework target is measured per sprint (so two-week window). I’ll add these definitions to the tracker so we have a shared baseline.

Updated plan (attached coaching_template.xlsx):
- Week 1 (this week): clarify scope and list of open tickets; define two priority tickets to close within 10 business days.
- Week 2: focused pairing sessions (Neha + Marissa, 2x 1-hr pairing) on the priority tickets.
- Week 3: independent delivery with daily short status updates in our 1:1 and standup.
- Week 4: retrospective and decision point — meet with Laura to review progress and next steps.

Evaluation criteria (SMART):
- S: Reduce open priority tickets owned by Marissa by 50% in 30 days.
- M: PR rework <= 2 per sprint.
- A: Pairing and defined acceptance criteria before dev.
- R: Metrics tracked in the shared tracker and in Jira queries.
- T: Decision at the end of Week 4 (July 12th meeting).

Please review the attached template and populate the "current blockers" section before our Wednesday 1:1. I’ll also send calendar invites for the pairing sessions.

Regards,
Neha

Attachments: coaching_template.xlsx

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, hrlegal@worklawpartners.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0000
Subject: Documentation & next steps (HR guidance)

Folks — adding a few HR-oriented notes so we keep this process consistent and defensible should we need to escalate. I’ve attached a short doc with recommended note-taking practices. Key points:

- Documentation: keep dated notes for each 1:1; save them in the shared Drive folder linked below. Avoid speculative language; stick to observable behaviors and outcomes.
- Notifications: the employee should have the opportunity to respond and provide mitigation/context at every checkpoint.
- Timeline: maintain the Week 4 decision point; if improvement is insufficient, HR will discuss options including a formal PIP.

Attachments: hr-recording-guidance.docx
Shared folder: https://redwood-drive.internal/Shared/PeopleOps/Marissa_Coaching

Action items for Neha: please upload your 1:1 notes after each meeting and keep Vivek notified of any material changes to the plan. For Marissa: thank you for pulling the examples and being responsive — that will help us evaluate fairly.

—Vivek

Subject: Re: Performance coaching roadmap — 30-day corrective support

Neha, Vivek, Marissa — I reviewed the template and the notes Vivek shared. I’m supportive of the proposed cadence and SMART criteria. Two quick clarifications:

1) If Marissa hits the Week 4 targets early, we’ll document the outcome and close the coaching plan; no further action required.
2) If there is partial improvement (mixed signals), we’ll extend an additional two-week focused plan before moving to a formal PIP — provided we see measurable progress in that extension.

Marissa — I’ll join the Week 4 review. Please send me the Jira filter you’re using so I can independently verify the metrics ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Laura
